programme.desc: The second season follows Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, and the rest of the cast as they prepare for the highly anticipated stage adaptation of Tokyo Blade. While the production unfolds, Aqua quietly continues his investigation into the mystery surrounding Ai Hoshino's death, uncovering new leads that could change everything. Blending compelling character drama with a behind-the-scenes look at Japan's entertainment industry, Oshi no Ko Season 2 explores talent, obsession, and the price of pursuing the truth.

programme.title: A Culinary Journey
programme.desc: A Culinary Journey takes viewers on a flavorful exploration of diverse culinary traditions across different regions. Each episode highlights local ingredients, time-honored recipes, and the stories of chefs, home cooks, and artisans who preserve their communities' food heritage. Combining travel, history, and gastronomy, the series celebrates how food reflects culture, identity, and everyday life.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz delivers comprehensive coverage of the entertainment world through the latest celebrity news, exclusive interviews, behind-the-scenes features, and updates on movies, television, music, and lifestyle. The program also highlights upcoming events, industry trends, and inspiring stories from artists and entertainers, providing viewers with a complete overview of the entertainment scene.

programme.title: The Borderless World
programme.desc: The Borderless World is a news magazine program that delivers in-depth reports on international affairs, global trends, and human-interest stories. Covering topics such as politics, business, technology, culture, and social issues, the program highlights how events around the world influence people's lives while presenting unique Taiwanese perspectives on international developments.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef is one of Taiwan's most popular cooking variety shows, produced by Sanlih E-Television. Hosted by Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo alongside renowned chefs James and Wu Bing-Cheng, the program blends cooking demonstrations with celebrity competitions, themed culinary challenges, and humorous studio interactions. Viewers can learn practical recipes, professional cooking techniques, and kitchen tips while enjoying lighthearted entertainment and appearances by popular Taiwanese celebrities.

programme.title: Battle Tour
programme.desc: Battle Tour is a travel reality program where celebrity teams design and experience travel itineraries based on different themes and budgets. Throughout each episode, the teams visit popular attractions, discover hidden gems, enjoy local cuisine, and share practical travel tips. At the end of the journey, a panel and audience determine which itinerary offers the most memorable and worthwhile travel experience.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Produced by Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night is a long-running variety program hosted by Jacky Wu alongside Chen Han-Dian and Lulu Huang. Each episode features celebrity guests competing in creative games, themed challenges, comedy segments, musical performances, and entertaining talk sessions. Blending humor, competition, and pop culture, the show has become one of Taiwan's highest-rated entertainment programs and has received multiple Golden Bell Award nominations and wins.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness follows the Wu family, led by a respected police officer and his supportive wife. Although he once dreamed of having a son to continue the family legacy, he instead dedicates his life to guiding his four daughters through the joys and hardships of adulthood. As their lives become intertwined with romance, ambition, betrayal, and family rivalries, the family faces countless trials that test their love and resilience. Blending heartfelt relationships with dramatic twists, the series delivers an emotional story about family bonds, forgiveness, and perseverance.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: Discover the fascinating traditions and folklore of Taiwan in The Tradition Story of Taiwan. Each episode delves into ancient legends, local customs, religious beliefs, historical figures, and cultural practices that continue to shape Taiwanese identity today. Combining storytelling with visits to historical sites and local communities, the program offers viewers an engaging journey through Taiwan's diverse cultural heritage and enduring traditions.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E3

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E4

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E5
programme.desc: Mayas online popularity was translated into her appearance. Asides from being more modernly-dressed, chic, and fashionable, her everyday schedule becomes tighter to a point where she feels overworked. With her grades as a casualty, Maya then decides to take a gap semester from college with the full support from her mother.

programme.title: Dunia Maya S1 E6
programme.desc: Maya's attempt to escape made Mariska even more overprotective over Maya. Maya landed a massive contract deal as a Brand Ambassador for a big beauty product line.
